name: Roof Gutter Maintenance
description: Guides homeowners through roof inspection, gutter cleaning, and maintenance tasks to prevent water damage, ice dams, and premature roof failure. Covers asphalt shingle, metal, tile, and flat roof types with specific inspection intervals and repair indicators. Use when the user asks about roof care, gutter cleaning schedules, leak prevention, or roof lifespan assessment. Do NOT use for full home maintenance planning (use annual-home-maintenance), active roof leak emergencies (use home-repair-first-response), or commercial roofing systems.
